data.description: 【西连寺春菜 · 落地穿衣镜前的侧影对视】黄昏的卧房角落，椭圆形落地镜前。春菜侧立在木地板上正整理衣着，镜子清晰映照出她轻挽耳发的身影。突然在镜中与站在门边的观众视线相撞，她像受惊的小鹿般僵在原地，整个人从耳垂红到脖颈。
data.promptProse: Standing in profile before a tall oval dressing mirror, Haruna has one hand raised to tuck her short purple hair behind her ear. As her eyes meet the viewer reflected in the glass, her posture tenses in bashful surprise, with soft evening window light rimming her shoulder and cheek.
